data.name: Sports articles for objectivity analysis
data.abstract: 1000 sports articles were labeled using Amazon Mechanical Turk as objective or subjective. The raw texts, extracted features, and the URLs from which the articles were retrieved are provided.

additional_info.summary: Some of the features are retrieved using the Stanford POS tagger and the tags are as defined in Penn Treebank Project:  https://www.ling.upenn.edu/courses/Fall_2003/ling001/penn_treebank_pos.html
